title: AI Medical Interpretation: Notice and Consent Policy
summary: Build an AI interpretation policy that separates patient notice, consent, recording permission, privacy, choice, and clinical escalation.
body_markdown:
###


No single universal rule should be assumed. Organizations should assess the specific technology, data use, recording status, setting, federal and state law, contracts, and internal policy with qualified counsel.


###


No. HIPAA authorization applies to certain uses or disclosures of protected health information. Interpretation choice, treatment consent, recording permission, and privacy authorization should be evaluated and documented separately.


###


Explain that AI is being used, what it does, what information it processes, whether recording or retention occurs, available options, known limitations, and how staff will respond if communication fails.


###


Stop the AI function, document the choice, offer another approved language-assistance method, and keep the clinician informed so care can continue safely.


###


Record language, modality, notice version, patient choice, staff member, date and time, recording permission when applicable, withdrawal, modality changes, and any communication failure or escalation.
